source.published_network_scope: daily flower-visit networks using Apis mellifera, Anthophora dispar and Bombus terrestris

reopened_rule_conflict.source_selection_rule: After source-native pooling, remove a date if either Anthophora dispar or Bombus terrestris has fewer than 10 non-volo observations.
reopened_rule_conflict.reason: The retained 29 daily networks are conditioned on focal-bee interaction counts. This is a legitimate source-defined network subset for the original paper, but it is not outcome-independent under the stricter post-promotion robustness-challenge freeze. Admitting it after applying the same stricter rule to Aegean would be inconsistent.

robustness_challenge_effect: No source is added. The four-candidate prospectively frozen robustness challenge is exhausted without an admissible additional source.
claim_boundary: This failure is specific to the stricter post-promotion robustness challenge. It does not invalidate the Giannutri source paper, the checksum-locked source reconstruction, the original six-source NEE route, or the source-defined 29-network analysis for other purposes.
